_meta.schema: Style Dictionary-style subset (templates/design-system.md): leaves carry { value, type }; {dotted.path} is a reference.
_meta.system: This repo's user-facing surface. Layer 00 (brand) says what the product is; this tier carries the atomic decisions every other layer binds to.
_meta.note: Three tiers: primitive (raw, named by what it IS) -> semantic (named by what it is FOR; the contract consuming code binds to) -> component (per-component narrowing of a semantic value). The component tier ships declared empty rather than populated with an invented narrowing: an entry earns its place when one component genuinely needs a single-use value.
_meta.capture: These values are a placeholder palette: they resolve, and they demonstrate the three tiers, but they are not a recommendation. Replace them with this product's own, keep the structure, and rebuild. The token builder resolves this source and writes only the marker-bounded region of the consuming page.

primitive._comment: A neutral ramp and four accent hues, each a de-facto three-step ramp (base/soft/ink). Primitives are never emitted as CSS variables; they resolve to literals inside the semantic values that reference them.

semantic._comment: The semantic token families the page consumes: surface, text, border, and loop accent/soft/ink roles; the generator maps them to the page's stable CSS custom properties.

component._comment: Ships empty: every shipped literal resolves through primitive -> semantic, and nothing here is single-use chrome. An entry narrows a semantic value for exactly one component, per templates/design-system.md.
